newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGUESE CHAMPIONS PORTO BEAT LEIRIA 3-0.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGUESE CHAMPIONS PORTO BEAT LEIRIA 3-0.

text.p: Portuguese champions Porto's Brazilian contingent led their team to its first victory of the season on Saturday when they scored all the goals in a 3-0 away win over Uniao de Leiria.

Porto, who meet Italy's AC Milan away on Wednesday in the European champions' league, got off to a poor start this season when they just managed a 2-2 draw against newly-promoted Setubal two weeks ago.

Leiria were reduced to 10 players in the 40th minute when defender Paulo Matias was sent off for a second bookable offence but put up a strong defence until the 70th minute when new Brazilian striker Mario Jardel opened the scoring with a header after a freekick from Serbian winger Ljubimko Drulovic.

Porto, now coached by former national coach Antonio Oliveira in place of England's Bobby Robson, extended their lead to 2-0 four minutes later with a powerful shot from another new Brazilian signing Artur Ferreira.

Porto put away their third in the 77th minute when Brazilian winger Edmilson Pimenta converted a penalty after a foul against him by defender Joao Armando who was sent off with a second yellow card, leaving Leiria with just nine men.

Sporting, who are still chasing the league title which has eluded them for 14 years, suffered their first set-back of the season when they only managed a goalless draw at home against Farense on Friday.
